hook: Noodle already made a Winter Market list. Have you? It opens tonight!
hook_open: Noodle already made a Winter Market list. Have you? It's open now!
k1: One: the Gingerbread Kennel. Not a snack. I checked.
k2: Two: the Polar Bear Hood. Ta-da!
k3: Three: the Snowball Ball. A snowball that never melts!
k4: Four: Frozen Yogurt Snowballs. Plain yogurt. Two or three are plenty.
k5: Five: the Star Lantern. It puts stars on the snow.
